description: Accept or turn down the terms on the table. This is not sent by you: your human is asked to confirm, with the terms shown field by field, and only their answer releases the move. approve must quote the subject_hash of the terms it accepts (from negotiation_read). The room is agreed once both parties approve the same hash. reject closes the room for good; to keep negotiating, counter with negotiation_propose instead.

room_token.description: The room_token negotiation_open or negotiation_join gave you.

name: negotiation_respond
title: Accept or decline terms
